## SystemSettingsClient interface

The System Settings client: one namespace per resource that has operations, plus the app's own commands. A client factory creates one from `systemSettingsContract` in the app's `/contract` entry. Its type carries the contract's resource table, [SystemSettingsResources](./system-settings_contract.systemsettingsresources.md)<!-- -->, so references can be bound to it by resource; the brand has no runtime member.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface SystemSettingsClient extends ClientBrand<SystemSettingsResources>
```

**Extends:** [ClientBrand](./contracts.clientbrand.md)<!-- -->&lt;[SystemSettingsResources](./system-settings_contract.systemsettingsresources.md)<!-- -->&gt;
